decisionQuestion: ما مقدار التأخير الإضافي فوق الازدحام الذي كان سيحدث حتى دون المشروع؟
validationMethod: Build the counterfactual from matched weekdays, season, weather and event conditions; report sensitivity to the matching window.
uncertainty: Report point estimate plus 80% and 95% intervals.
antiClaimRule: Never attribute total corridor congestion to the work zone.
prototypeDisplay: Baseline, work-zone and recommended curves on the same hourly chart.

decisionQuestion: كم ساعة مركبة يوفرها الجدول المقترح مقارنة بطلب الجهة كما ورد؟
validationMethod: Back-test both scenarios on historical demand and compare the approved scenario with observed pilot travel times.
uncertainty: Show low, central and high demand cases.
antiClaimRule: Do not scale nationally until the annual permit volume and representativeness are sourced.
prototypeDisplay: Large before-and-after number with a confidence band.

decisionQuestion: كم وقتًا يستعيده السكان فعليًا، بعد احتساب إشغال المركبات؟
validationMethod: Use authority-approved occupancy by vehicle and trip class; publish any assumed occupancy separately.
uncertainty: Vary occupancy within documented bounds.
antiClaimRule: Do not equate vehicle-hours with human-hours.
prototypeDisplay: People-hours above vehicle-hours to make the resident outcome explicit.

decisionQuestion: ما القيمة المالية لساعة الوقت حسب غرض الرحلة؟
formula: hourlyWage = monthlyWage / (4.33 * weeklyHours); commuteVOT = 0.50 * hourlyWage; businessVOT = 1.00 * hourlyWage * 1.18; truckingVOT = truckingHourlyWage * 1.20
validationMethod: Replace the national demo wage with trip-purpose and sector-specific values in the pilot.
uncertainty: Publish the wage, hours and trip-purpose mix used.
judgeUse: Feasibility, expected impact and prototype quality
antiClaimRule: The Q1 2026 national wage is a labeled demo input, not a universal traveler wage.
prototypeDisplay: Expandable calculation showing every parameter and source.

decisionQuestion: كم تساوي منافع الوقت للبديل المقترح؟
validationMethod: Recalculate with low, central and high trip-purpose shares and compare with observed demand composition.
uncertainty: Report a range rather than a single false-precision total.
antiClaimRule: Do not add vehicle-hours and person-hours or use one flat value for all travel.
prototypeDisplay: Central estimate with a range and a source drill-down.

decisionQuestion: ما التكلفة المجتمعية التي يتجنبها الخيار المقترح؟
validationMethod: Display each component separately and monetize only components with localized unit values.
uncertainty: Allow unmonetized components to remain physical indicators.
antiClaimRule: Do not fill missing Saudi crash or emissions prices with unlabeled foreign values.
prototypeDisplay: Stacked components with unavailable values visibly marked.

decisionQuestion: كم انبعاثًا يتجنبه تقليل التوقف والتحويلات والمسافة؟
validationMethod: Calibrate fleet mix and speeds; compare modeled fuel or emissions against sensor or fleet data where available.
uncertainty: Publish fleet-mix and factor ranges.
antiClaimRule: Show physical emissions first; do not monetize the code's 2005 SAR factors without a documented update.
prototypeDisplay: Kilograms avoided plus the assumptions behind the factor.

decisionQuestion: كم وقتًا إضافيًا يحتاج المستخدم كي يصل في موعده في معظم الأيام؟
validationMethod: Compute by corridor, direction and peak period before, during and after work.
uncertainty: Require a minimum interval sample count.
antiClaimRule: Do not use citywide reliability to claim project causality.
prototypeDisplay: Reliability badge next to average delay.

decisionQuestion: كم من وقت العمل تجاوز الطابور الحد الذي تحدده الجهة؟
validationMethod: Separate queues caused by crashes, weather and recurrent congestion from those due to closure activity.
uncertainty: Flag sensor coverage gaps.
judgeUse: Problem solving, expected impact and prototype quality
antiClaimRule: Do not combine exogenous incident queues with work-caused queues.
prototypeDisplay: Traffic-light threshold with the percentage of work time exceeded.

decisionQuestion: ما أبعد امتداد للطابور وهل تجاوز نطاق التحذير؟
validationMethod: Compare probe-derived and field-observed queue endpoints for a sample of periods.
uncertainty: Report spatial resolution and detection lag.
antiClaimRule: A momentary maximum must not be presented as an average.
prototypeDisplay: Map extent with maximum and typical queue.

decisionQuestion: هل يقترب الطريق أو المدخل من عدم الاستقرار أو يتجاوزه؟
validationMethod: Calibrate effective capacity from observed discharge rates by work-zone configuration.
uncertainty: Show the capacity assumption and a sensitivity band.
judgeUse: Problem solving, innovation and prototype quality
antiClaimRule: Use 0.5 and 1.0 as code-aligned flags with the adaptation caveat, not excavation-law thresholds.
prototypeDisplay: Gauge with explainable warning levels.

decisionQuestion: كم محطة ومسارًا ورحلة نقل عام تقع داخل نطاق التأثير؟
validationMethod: Spatially validate sampled intersections and route geometries against the current official catalog.
uncertainty: Display dataset modification date.
judgeUse: Problem solving, innovation and expected impact
antiClaimRule: Do not convert nearby stops into affected passenger counts without service and ridership data.
prototypeDisplay: Affected stops and lines highlighted on the project map.

decisionQuestion: هل يزيد المشروع زمن الوصول إلى مستشفى أو مدرسة أو محطة رئيسية؟
validationMethod: Test representative origins and emergency-access paths with the authority.
uncertainty: Report facility type, time period and origin set.
antiClaimRule: Do not imply emergency-service endorsement without formal review.
prototypeDisplay: Critical-access warning card with affected facilities.

decisionQuestion: كم ضغطًا مشتركًا تصنعه المشاريع المتزامنة على المحور نفسه؟
validationMethod: Compare detected conflicts with expert coordination records and accepted schedule changes.
uncertainty: Show whether flow is observed, modeled or assumed.
antiClaimRule: Spatial overlap alone is not a traffic conflict; temporal overlap and shared network effect are required.
prototypeDisplay: Conflict timeline and shared-corridor heat.

decisionQuestion: كم تعارضًا عالي الأثر أزاله الجدول المقترح؟
validationMethod: Have municipal traffic reviewers label true conflicts and false positives.
uncertainty: Publish precision and recall for conflict detection.
antiClaimRule: Do not count every overlapping geometry as an avoided conflict.
prototypeDisplay: Before-and-after schedule with removed red conflicts.

decisionQuestion: هل تنخفض الشكاوى بعد تحسين الجدولة والتواصل؟
validationMethod: Deduplicate complaints, classify topic and normalize by exposure.
uncertainty: Report complaint-channel coverage and linkage confidence.
antiClaimRule: Raw complaint counts cannot be compared across projects of different duration or exposure.
prototypeDisplay: Complaint trend and dominant themes.

decisionQuestion: هل يقل زمن التحليل دون تجاوز مهلة المراجعة؟
validationMethod: Compare shadow-mode review time with the existing manual or system-assisted baseline.
uncertainty: Separate incomplete applications and paused cases.
antiClaimRule: Do not claim faster permit issuance when only the analysis step was timed.
prototypeDisplay: Analysis time and full review time as separate values.

decisionQuestion: ما نسبة توصيات الجدولة التي يقبلها المراجع أو صاحب المشروع؟
validationMethod: Record rejection reason categories and reviewer role.
uncertainty: Report sample size and confidence interval.
antiClaimRule: Acceptance is not proof of traffic benefit; pair it with observed outcomes.
prototypeDisplay: Acceptance funnel with reasons.

decisionQuestion: ما دقة توقع زمن الرحلة أو التأخير؟
validationMethod: Use a locked holdout set split by corridor and time; also report error by impact tier.
uncertainty: Exclude or separately report near-zero denominators.
antiClaimRule: Do not report training error as validation accuracy.
prototypeDisplay: Accuracy badge with sample count and validation window.

decisionQuestion: كم دقيقة يخطئ النموذج عادة مع وزن أكبر للأخطاء الكبيرة؟
validationMethod: Compute on the same locked holdout as MAPE.
uncertainty: Bootstrap a confidence interval.
antiClaimRule: Always report RMSE with MAPE and sample size.
prototypeDisplay: Minutes of error by corridor class.

decisionQuestion: هل تقع النتائج الفعلية داخل نطاق عدم اليقين المتوقع بالمعدل المعلن؟
validationMethod: Compare empirical coverage with the nominal 80% and 95% targets.
uncertainty: Report interval width alongside coverage.
antiClaimRule: A very wide interval is not useful merely because it covers observations.
prototypeDisplay: Coverage versus target with average interval width.

decisionQuestion: هل تكفي البيانات لإصدار توصية قابلة للدفاع؟
validationMethod: Test against complete and intentionally incomplete applications.
uncertainty: Fields may be present but stale or inaccurate; validity is scored separately.
antiClaimRule: Do not issue a high-confidence impact score below the authority-approved completeness threshold.
prototypeDisplay: Data-quality gate before the recommendation.

decisionQuestion: كم مضى على تحديث بيانات المشروع والسرعة والأجهزة؟
validationMethod: Apply source-specific service levels and reject stale live feeds.
uncertainty: Catalog update date is not the same as observation time.
antiClaimRule: Do not label a static annual layer as real time.
prototypeDisplay: Freshness badge per layer.

decisionQuestion: هل يستطيع السجل الخروج كبيانات قابلة للاستهلاك من التطبيقات والمركبات؟
validationMethod: Run schema validation and publish a sample feed with synthetic identifiers.
uncertainty: Conformance does not guarantee downstream publication agreements.
antiClaimRule: Do not claim navigation-app integration until an actual consumer accepts the feed.
prototypeDisplay: Schema validation result and sample feed preview.

decisionQuestion: هل تتجاوز المنافع المحققة تكلفة التشغيل والتكامل؟
validationMethod: Publish excluded benefits, cost boundary and sensitivity cases.
uncertainty: Use a range for projected benefits and include integration and data-license costs.
antiClaimRule: Do not annualize a short pilot without a sourced scaling denominator and representativeness test.
prototypeDisplay: Benefit-cost range with included and excluded components.

decisionQuestion: هل ينقل البديل الضرر من طريق رئيسي إلى حي أو خدمة حساسة؟
formula: report(delayChange, exposureChange, transitImpact, criticalAccessImpact) by zone and user group
validationMethod: Review detours and distributional shifts with local planners and affected-service owners.
uncertainty: Do not infer demographic attributes where no authoritative or consented data exist.
judgeUse: Problem solving, innovation and expected impact
antiClaimRule: A networkwide average must not hide localized harm.
prototypeDisplay: Map of winners, neutral areas and burden shifts.
